# Steylish – Danny Stey

> Danny Stey (Steylish) is a freelance senior fullstack engineer and interim technical lead based in Mühldorf am Inn, Germany. He provides interim team leadership and senior frontend/backend engineering, mentors developers and acts as a sparring partner for CTOs on architecture, strategy and scaling. Working in German and English, for clients across Germany and Austria.

## Services

- **Immersive web experiences**: high-performance 3D web experiences with WebGL and Three.js, built with senior fullstack expertise.
- **Interim technical leadership**: stabilizing complex codebases, optimizing development workflows, turning technical debt into solid architecture and mentoring teams, including AI-enhanced workflows. Based on experience as Head of Engineering.
- **Digital modernization**: modernizing software architecture so it becomes future-proof, flexible and secure, either as a complete rebuild or step by step.
- **AI prototype professionalization**: auditing, refactoring and hardening AI-generated applications (e.g. built with Claude or Lovable) to make them production-ready: security, scaling, performance and architecture.
- **AI-supported software development**: modern AI tools for high efficiency and fast delivery, combined with over 17 years of software engineering experience for the best quality: clean, maintainable and secure code.

## Background

- Since 2023: freelance engineer (web development, consulting, team leadership). Clients include rc-tec, pixx.io, coma, collect.AI, WAF Seminare, shareDnC, Buzzin Monkey, Pentacoastal, Ideenbude and ALM Engineering.
- 2021–2023: Head of Engineering & Team Lead Frontend at pixx.io (digital asset management).
- 2019: Senior Frontend Architect at Virtual Identity, Munich (projects for Infineon, Munich Re, Caritas).
- 2010–2019: coma, Munich, from web developer to Head of Development (teams in Munich and Valencia).
- Education: Bachelor of Engineering in media technology, TH Deggendorf.
- Skills: Svelte, Vue, React, Angular, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Three.js · Laravel, Symfony, PHP, NestJS, Node.js, SQL, Redis, MongoDB · leadership, coaching, Scrum, software architecture.
